featured_reviews.review_text: I joined Behzaad Fitness as a new year resolution for getting back to some exercise. So on January 1, I went for a free trial session of Tabata. My wife had joined this about 4 months ago and I could see it was doing her a lot of good. So she had been after me to join Tabata for quite some time. I was very impressed with the trial and signed up with them the same day. Since then I have been going regularly for these classes and I am quite sure ill continue going. Even though I was new to this group, it just took a few days to get familiar and comfortable with the other members. It is like one big family. One of the best fitness studios in South Mumbai side. It’s been almost a year attending classes and it has transformed me to a much healthy version of myself. I love attending Pilates, Yin Yoga,  Strength and Cardio sessions!

Schedule flexibility is what makes this space unique! Trainers are friendly and qualified, which results in quality sessions.

featured_reviews.name: vaishali mishra
featured_reviews.review_text:
Being part of this studio over the past two years has genuinely been one of the best decisions I’ve made for my health and fitness. I’m noticeably stronger, fitter, and more confident in my abilities than when I first started — and that progress says a lot about the environment here.

The instructors are incredibly knowledgeable, attentive, and truly professional. They focus on form, safety, and pushing you just the right amount, so you’re constantly improving without feeling overwhelmed.

What truly makes this place special is the energy. The vibe is positive, motivating, and welcoming, and the variety in workouts keeps things fresh and challenging. Training alongside a driven and encouraging group of people makes every session something to look forward to.

featured_reviews.name: Tanuja Gahane
featured_reviews.review_text: Recently joined the Studio one life by Rebant. The trainers are highly professional, experienced, approachable and pay attention to each and every one around. The studio maintains excellent cleanliness. Infact the classes are cleaned after each session. The sessions are fun, high-energy, and suitable for all fitness levels. The music, atmosphere, and group vibe make exercising feel less like a task and more like an experience. They also provide with flexible timings so you can join with any one of the classes for the day. That feels like the best hour of the day indeed. Kudos to Rebant, Harshita and their team for all the efforts and attention they put in.

featured_reviews.name: Jaya Yadav
featured_reviews.review_text:
If mornings had a personality, mine would definitely be Studio1 Life.

I’ve been coming here since October’25 mostly for yoga (with a recent Zumba comeback 💃)and honestly, it’s become my favourite part of the day.

The yoga classes with Akshay (and sometimes Rebant) are anything but routine. Every single session feels fresh, thoughtfully designed and just the right mix of challenge and energising. From power yoga to Pilates to yin yoga: each class is like a mini reset button for the mind, body and soul.

What I love most; The instructors are absolute pros, focused, attentive and genuinely invested in you. They keep things engaging without any fluff… it’s fun, but with purpose.

And then there’s Zumba with Rebant, pure joy! It’s not just a workout, it’s a full-on vibe. The music, the energy, the steps… one minute you’re in Mumbai, the next you’re dancing your way through Mexico or Spain 🌍🔥

If you’re looking for a place that makes you want to wake up to the rhythm of your body,  this is it. Highly recommend!

featured_reviews.name: Karishma Taurani
featured_reviews.review_text: I'm absolutely loving this workout Studo 1! 🤩 They've got an insane variety of classes - Pilates, yoga, strength training, Zumba... you name it! The trainers are top-notch with full of energy, always pushing me to be my best self. What I love most is the flexibility - no advance booking needed, just show up and get moving. :) Whether you're a fitness newbie or a seasoned pro, this place has got you covered.

I am writing this with deep frustration and genuine concern for the safety and rights of members. This gym has proven to be by far the most poorly managed, negligent, & misleading fitness establishment I have ever been associated with. From the very first day, the experience has been consistently negative, marked by operational failures, false commitments, and utter lack of accountability.
1.	Trainer negligence leading to injury: Due to inexperienced trainers & poor supervision, I suffered a severe neck injury, resulting in more than three months of recovery. This happened during a paid personal training session — something that should have been safe and professionally handled.
2.	False advertising of classes: Zumba, Yoga, Pilates, and Bollywood Dance sessions are irregular, frequently canceled, and often happen without any notice. What they promote in their brochure and what they actually deliver are completely different.
3.	Extremely delayed maintenance: It took them three months to repair the ice bath tub, and even then, they refused to extend memberships or compensate members for the downtime. This reflects their complete disregard for customer rights.
4.	Poor air-conditioning: The gym floor often feels like a furnace because of ineffective or non-functional air conditioning. Despite repeated complaints, there is no resolution.
5.	Lack of basic equipment: The gym has only 2 barbell locks for 5 machines. If you request more, you’re passed from one staff member to another, and the issue remains unresolved. This is basic gym infrastructure, not a luxury. Its been a month since the request was placed.
6.	Non-functional steam room: The steam facility hardly works. A staff member has to manually monitor the switch for it to run. It’s both unsafe and unacceptable for a premium-priced gym.
7.	Sales over safety: Trainers are more focused on aggressively pushing personal training packages than helping members with proper form, guidance, or safety.
8.	Misleading personal training model: Even during a paid personal training slot, trainers frequently handle multiple clients simultaneously, turning a one-on-one session into an overcrowded group class. Members are rushed, and the quality of training is compromised. This is a clear case of misrepresentation of services.
9.	Delayed and poor-quality diet chart: Despite multiple reminders and follow-ups, I received my personal training diet chart only after 5 months of enrolling. And when it was finally shared, it was shockingly basic and generic. Something that does not reflect any personalized goal-setting or professional nutrition planning. Frankly, such a diet plan does not even qualify to be called a “chart.” This is a clear failure to deliver what was promised as part of the personal training package.
10.	Severe safety lapses: During peak hours, all treadmills abruptly stopped due to an unplanned “maintenance.” Multiple members, including me, could have been injured. This incident alone is enough to question the gym’s safety protocols.
11.	Zero accountability: When issues are escalated, staff either pass the blame or respond with scripted, robotic lines. There is no escalation matrix, no ownership, and no intent to resolve genuine member grievances.
12.	Brand endorsement is misleading: Don’t be fooled by celebrity branding. MS Dhoni is not running the operations here. The ground reality is a disorganized, unsafe, and poorly managed facility.

⸻

👉 Final Statement:
This is not just a bad experience — it’s a case of gross mismanagement, service deficiency, and potential consumer rights violation. If you’re considering joining this gym, please reconsider. There are far better-managed facilities that actually value member safety, experience, and trust.

For an establishment charging a premium, such repeated negligence, misrepresentation, and lack of accountability is unacceptable. I reserve the right to escalate this matter to consumer protection authorities and relevant fitness licensing bodies.

Choose wisely. Don’t fall for the brand name — look at the ground reality.
